cho_historical_source_attribution: CHO verification confirmed by the project team for the uploaded 2018-2026 source.
synthetic_supplement_training_policy: The earlier explicitly synthetic 2018-2019 submissions remain archived and excluded; the newer 2018-2019 CHO-verified submissions are included in the active source.
training_weather_source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API ERA5 for gap-filled rows; existing per-barangay archive values retained for other periods
training_weather_scope: One boundary-derived representative point per official barangay; modeled grid-cell estimates, and adjacent barangays may share grid cells.
outer_split_policy: Chronological approximately 75/25 outer split by whole reference month; all barangays from a month remain in one partition. The earlier 75% development period is internally split into fitting and validation periods for model selection.
validation_model_selection_rule: Highest unweighted chronological validation hotspot accuracy among RandomForestRegressor parameter candidates at the configured predicted-count cutoff (3), subject to precision >= 85% and recall >= 40%; ties use higher F1, then lower case-count MAE.
validation_objective: Maximize unweighted hotspot classification accuracy subject to at least 85% precision and 40% recall; ties use F1, case-count MAE, then lower cutoff.

hotspot_classification_evaluation.task: Flag barangays for planning review using the predicted-count cutoff; the observed hotspot label has a separate actual-case threshold.

training_objective: Select the Random Forest settings and predicted-count cutoff by validation hotspot accuracy subject to minimum precision and recall constraints; every training row has equal weight.
baseline_comparison_rule: Retain as a candidate for further evaluation only if model MAE and RMSE both beat persistence, seasonal-naive, and trailing-3-month-mean baselines over the full final test and every consecutive four-month block.
hotspot_classification_retention_rule: The model must also have a higher hotspot F1 than persistence, seasonal-naive, and trailing-3-month-mean baselines overall and in every consecutive four-month test block. Precision, recall, F1, and confusion counts are reported separately from count errors.
blood_type_feature_policy: Blood type remains available only for aggregate historical profile display; it is excluded from machine-learning inputs because it is not part of the study prediction framework.
weather_feature_policy: Uses rainfall, mean temperature, and mean relative humidity observed through the forecast issue month, plus their one-month lags. Missing weather values are imputed within the training-fitted pipeline.
case_history_feature_policy: For a one-month-ahead forecast, case-count inputs are the two latest complete months available at forecast issue time: the issue month and the immediately preceding month. Partial current month reports are excluded. Older case lags and rolling case averages are not model inputs.
geographic_feature_policy: Uses official barangay identity and boundary-derived representative latitude/longitude as geographic inputs; GIS polygons remain the map visualization layer.
privacy_protections: Lag aggregate features by one month to prevent future-data leakage.
Do not include individual blood-type values in forecast outputs.
target: recorded dengue case count in the next calendar month
hotspot_definition: At a forecast issue cutoff in calendar month t, DengueWatch uses the dengue case and weather information available by that cutoff, including the two latest complete monthly case counts, to estimate the recorded dengue case count in calendar month t+1 for each of Iligan City's 44 barangays (one barangay-month prediction, one calendar month ahead). The target is the observed case-record count in the following month, not a risk label calculated from the input month's count. A barangay is flagged for planning review if its estimated t+1 count is at least 3; evaluation labels an observed hotspot at 2 or more actual cases. These are internal project thresholds, not official DOH outbreak definitions. If month t is still underway, confirmed month-to-date cases are used and the estimate is provisional. Forecasts support planning and require health-personnel review before operational action.
preprocessing_fit_policy: For candidate selection, preprocessing is fitted on training months only and applied to validation months. For the final test evaluation, preprocessing is fitted on the earlier training plus validation months; final-test rows are never used to fit preprocessing or select parameters.
temporal_partition_policy: Partitions are chronological and grouped by whole reference calendar month, so all barangays from the same month remain in one partition.
final_test_policy: Hyperparameters are selected on validation data; the later-period holdout is not used for parameter selection within a run. This holdout has been inspected in prior project iterations and is not an untouched independent test for new changes. Deployment refitting occurs only after metrics are recorded.
forecast_issue_information_policy: Predictors are limited to the issue-month case/weather values and lagged values available at that forecast cutoff; the next-month target and all later observations are excluded from features.
final_deployment_fit_policy: After the test score is recorded, the deployment pipeline is refit without sample weights on all available usable historical rows.
warning: Planning-support forecast only; validate with authorized health personnel. It must not be used as a confirmed outbreak or an automatic alert.
source_data_quality_note: No unverified empty barangay-month cells were used for this training run. 1368 empty cells were treated as zero under the user's dataset-completeness confirmation; no separate CHO zero-report register was provided.
